result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom tab bar all render consistently. Excluding the expected carousel edge-clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, two visual problems remain: the bottom navigation's active state contradicts the visible content (Profile tab highlighted while the Home feed is shown), and the promo banner's decorative circles are clipped by the banner's right edge.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active tab (green icon and label) while the screen content is clearly the Home feed (delivery address, search, categories, restaurant lists). The 'Home' tab appears inactive, so the selected-state indicator contradicts the displayed screen.
issues.suggestion: Sync the tab bar's selected state with the visible route: highlight 'Home' (green) while the home feed is shown and leave 'Profile' in its inactive gray state, or navigate to the profile screen if Profile is intended to be active.

issues.description: The decorative translucent circles on the green '3 free deliveries' promo banner are cut off abruptly at the banner's right edge, producing hard flat edges instead of soft circular shapes.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative circles to the banner's rounded rectangle (overflow hidden) and reposition/resize them so they read as intentional circular accents rather than shapes sliced by the container edge.
